Create Sample From Lab Order.description: Registers a sample (AnalysisRequest) in a client's folder from an EMR lab order.

Create Client.description: Adds a referring facility as a SENAITE client.

Receive Sample.description: Runs the receive workflow transition on a sample when it arrives at the lab.

Update Object By UID.description: Updates any SENAITE object's fields by UID.

Deactivate Client.description: Deactivates (soft-deletes) a client; SENAITE keeps the audit trail.
Deactivate Client.code:
// Deactivate an object. SENAITE does not hard-delete content.
request('POST', `Client/delete/${$.data.clientUid}`);

Get Published Results.description: Fetches samples published since a date, with full data, to send results back to an EMR or DHIS2.

Find Sample By Client Sample ID.description: Looks up a sample using the order number from the EMR.

Get Object By UID.description: Reads one sample, client or other object by UID.
Get Object By UID.code:
// Read a single object by UID.
request('GET', `AnalysisRequest/${$.data.sampleUid}`);

List Analysis Services.description: Lists the tests the lab offers, e.g. to map EMR test concepts to SENAITE UIDs.
